title: Anthropic is alone in every AI policy fight. It’s winning anyway.

content_html:
Six months ago, Anthropic was the darling of America’s AI boom. It led on the models and was loudest on the ethics. This summer, it finds itself alone.

The Claude maker is now the odd one out in nearly every big AI policy fight, Axios reported. It is the most valuable startup in the world, and at the same time the most isolated lab in the industry. The two facts turn out to be connected.

Alone on open weights

The clearest sign came last week. Anthropic was the only frontier lab that declined to sign an open letter urging Washington not to restrict open-weight models. Nvidia’s Jensen Huang led it. Google and OpenAI, its two closest rivals, both signed. That left Anthropic defending tighter controls on the very business model all three still lean on.

Dario Amodei tried to calm the row himself. In a blog post, Anthropic’s chief executive insisted the company has never called for banning open models. He even called weaker ones “a public good.”

He still did not sign. He also held his line that the dangerous ingredients, chiefly advanced chips reaching authoritarian states, need tighter control.

Isolated on every other front too

The pattern repeats across the board. The Pentagon blacklisted Anthropic in February, after a fight over whether Claude could be used for surveillance or autonomous weapons. One senior defence official said on Friday there was “no AI company more hostile to the warfighter.”

On safety, Anthropic has pushed harder than anyone. It has backed state AI laws and floated an FAA-style regulator to vet models before release. Yet when the White House flagged a security flaw this summer, Anthropic disputed how serious it was. The row helped trigger export controls that forced two of its models offline for nearly three weeks.

Then there is distillation. Anthropic has accused Chinese labs of training cheaper models on Claude’s outputs in “industrial-scale” campaigns, the New York Times reported.

Critics call distillation a normal part of AI development. They also note the awkward timing. Anthropic had just settled a $1.5bn copyright lawsuit over pirated books used to train its own models.

The isolation is not total. Anthropic did join more than 1,100 employees from rival labs this week in a petition urging Washington to help “deliberately pace” frontier AI. Its central worry, that the technology is moving faster than anyone can safely steer it, is now shared across the industry.

And for all the friction, Anthropic is not losing. Its models still top most independent benchmarks, and enterprises keep paying premium prices despite the grumbling over cost and restrictions. It reached a $965bn valuation in May, ahead of OpenAI, and is heading for an IPO that could value it higher still.

The traits that strand it in every policy fight, caution and a refusal to bend, are the same ones that built its lead. Anthropic would rather be right than liked, and for now it can afford to be.

content_html_zh:
六个月前，Anthropic 是美国人工智能热潮中的宠儿。 它在模型方面处于领先地位，并且在道德方面的声音最大。 今年夏天，它发现自己孤身一人。

据 Axios 报道，克劳德的制造者现在几乎在每一次重大的人工智能政策斗争中都是一个奇怪的人。 它是世界上最有价值的初创公司，同时也是业内最孤立的实验室。 事实证明，这两个事实是相互关联的。

独自进行开放式举重

最明显的迹象出现在上周。 Anthropic 是唯一一个拒绝签署​​公开信、敦促华盛顿不要限制开放重量模型的前沿实验室。 英伟达 (Nvidia) 的黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 领导了这项工作。 谷歌和 OpenAI 这两个最接近的竞争对手都签署了协议。 这使得 Anthropic 不得不捍卫对这三者仍然依赖的商业模式进行更严格的控制。

达里奥·阿莫代试图亲自平息这场争吵。 Anthropic 首席执行官在一篇博客文章中坚称，该公司从未呼吁禁止开放模型。 他甚至称弱势群体为“公共利益”。

他还是没有签字。 他还坚持认为，危险成分，主要是到达独裁国家的先进芯片，需要更严格的控制。

在其他方面也被隔离

这种模式在整个棋盘上重复出现。 在围绕克劳德是否可以用于监视或自主武器展开争论后，五角大楼于二月份将 Anthropic 列入了黑名单。 一位高级国防官员周五表示，“没有一家人工智能公司对战士更加敌意。”

在安全方面，Anthropic 比任何人都更加努力。 它支持各州的人工智能法律，并提出了一个类似美国联邦航空管理局(FAA)的监管机构，在模型发布前对其进行审查。 然而，当白宫今年夏天指出一个安全漏洞时，Anthropic 对其严重程度提出了质疑。 这一事件引发了出口管制，迫使其两款车型停产近三周。

然后是蒸馏。 据《纽约时报》报道，Anthropic 指责中国实验室在“工业规模”活动中利用克劳德的成果训练更便宜的模型。

批评者称蒸馏是人工智能开发的正常部分。 他们还注意到了尴尬的时机。 Anthropic 刚刚和解了一起价值 15 亿美元的版权诉讼，该诉讼涉及用于训练其模型的盗版书籍。

隔离并不完全。 Anthropic 本周确实与竞争对手实验室的 1,100 多名员工一起请愿，敦促华盛顿帮助“有意识地加快”前沿人工智能的步伐。 它的核心担忧是，技术的发展速度快于任何人都可以安全地驾驭它，现在整个行业都认同这一点。

尽管存在种种摩擦，Anthropic 并没有失败。 它的模型仍然在大多数独立基准测试中名列前茅，尽管成本和限制方面存在抱怨，但企业仍继续支付高价。 5 月份，该公司的估值达到了 9650 亿美元，领先于 OpenAI，并且即将进行 IPO，这可能会使其估值更高。

它在每次政策斗争中都表现出谨慎和拒绝屈服的特征，这与它建立领先地位的特征相同。 人择宁愿是正确的，也不愿被喜欢的，而且目前它有能力做到这一点。
